### MDSH Student, Biostatistics
University of California, Los Angeles  
**Research Advisor(s):** Jin Zhou, Hua Zhou  
**Cohort:** Fall 2025  








### Bio:

My work focuses on building scalable and reliable AI systems for clinical data. I develop machine learning pipelines and data workflows that integrate heterogeneous healthcare data and support real-world deployment. I work at the interface of machine learning, data engineering, and clinical applications, and aim to translate large-scale health data into practical, data-driven solutions for improving patient outcomes.
